name: Fairy Grunge
reacts_against: fairycore's unbroken prettiness, deliberately smudging and distressing it to add a darker, more lived-in edge.
article: Fairy grunge emerged on TikTok around 2020–21 as a direct, openly stated fusion of two aesthetics that had been circulating separately: fairycore's ethereal, flower-crown softness and grunge's dark, distressed texture. The combination — smudged black eyeliner paired with butterfly wings, ripped tights under sheer fabric — reads as a kind of corrective to fairycore's unbroken sweetness, adding grunge's grit without abandoning fairycore's fantastical imagery altogether. Like several other recent internet-aesthetic fusions on this list (rococopunk is another), fairy grunge is best understood not as an organic subculture with its own independent history but as a moodboard-level combination of two already-named aesthetics, assembled and circulated within internet fashion-content culture rather than growing out of any lived scene.

findings: dark — about 63% of the measured color across 6 wiki images is below mid-lightness
mostly muted — about 95% of the measured color is low-saturation (greys, dusty tones)
measured.caveat: Colors measured from Aesthetics Wiki images as photographed and displayed on screen; actual materials vary, and screen colors are approximate.
